the route

Three travellers on the places that stayed with them after they returned home.

“At Kelimutu, the clouds opened just as the first light reached the lakes. It felt less like arriving at a viewpoint and more like being let in on a secret.”
Maya ChenPhotographer · Singapore
“Raja Ampat changed the pace of our entire trip. Boat rides, reef swims and long dinners became the itinerary.”
Owen BrooksDesigner · Melbourne
“The quiet at Ulun Danu before the day visitors arrived was worth every minute of the early start.”
Sofia ReyesWriter · Madrid
